thread:
Priya (eng-platform): quick sync — we got a customer concern: they saw requests sent to hosted when their Dedicated pool was briefly unhealthy. They expect strict isolation for Dedicated contracts.
Marco: do we have a policy that prefers Dedicated 100% until unreachable? I thought we had 'prefer' not 'require'.
Jo (eng-sre): correct — current handshake is `prefer_dedicated` with a timeout -> fallback. That was by design to avoid drops during transient infra flaps.
Priya (eng-platform): product/legal want a 'no-hosted' mode for tenants with paid isolation. Can we map that to routing config + console flag?
Lina (eng-runtime): technically easy — we have a per-tenant enum: `required_dedicated`, `preferred`, `best_effort`. `required_dedicated` would reject (503) if Dedicated not available.
Marco: important: metrics and UX. If we flip to `required_dedicated` we need clear telemetry + quota behavior so customers don't think we're silently rate-limiting.
Jo (eng-sre): +1. Add an alert when a tenant is tripped into rejection state. Otherwise SEs will get floods of tickets.
Priya (eng-platform): Console needs to show a single toggle, language: "Enforce dedicated-only routing (reject to hosted)" and an explanation of billing implications.
Console Bot: note — existing rollout page has a `spilloverStrategy` dropdown. We'll add `rejection` option and wire to tenant config API.
Marco: telemetry: we should emit `tenant_routing_decision` with fields: `tenant_id`, `decision` (served_dedicated / served_hosted / rejected), `variant` (model-quantized / model-vanilla), and `reason` (capacity_unavailable / degraded_kernel / policy).
Priya (eng-platform): good. Also we need to think about model variant fallback: some customers allow hosted but only on quantized variants. Can we support per-tenant variant whitelist?
Lina (eng-runtime): yes — runtime already supports `allowed_variants` in routing proto. Example policy snippet:```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: required_dedicated
  allowed_variants:
    - model-q4b
    - model-int8
  fallback_hosted_variants: []
```
Marco: for tenants that want strict isolation but accept lower quality, we can offer `required_dedicated` with `allowed_variants` restricted to smaller memory footprints, but only within Dedicated pools.
Jo (eng-sre): edge case: if Dedicated returns degraded kernel errors frequently for a particular variant, should we auto-promote to hosted variant? That violates isolation; need explicit admin override.
Priya (eng-platform): policy: auto-fallback to hosted must be opt-in per-tenant. Default for enterprise contracts is opt-out.
Lina (eng-runtime): agree. We'll add a circuit-breaker metric: `dedicated_variant_error_rate` per tenant+variant. If > threshold, we'll mark variant unhealthy and stop routing to it, but only within the same availability domain; no automatic cross-environment fallback.
Marco: UI ask: show per-variant health and last N errors, plus an explicit "allow hosted fallback for this tenant/variant" checkbox that logs consent.
Console Bot: dev note — checkbox ties to API `tenant.override_hosted_fallback = true` and requires audit log + billing notice.
Jo (eng-sre): ops ask: if a tenant is `required_dedicated` and we return 503, should we surface an offer to route to hosted for a fee? maybe a soft fail path where request returns info header `x-rr-offer-hosted=yes` with a tokenized confirmation link.
Priya (eng-platform): interesting product idea. Not for M0 contracts. Keep it simple for now: config options + observability + explicit consent path.
Lina (eng-runtime): plan: implement API field + routing proto changes, emit the `tenant_routing_decision` event, and add per-tenant variant health stream in Console. I'll pair with Marco on the telemetry schema.
Marco: I can add the dashboards: 1) tenant-level served_breakdown (dedicated/hosted/rejected), 2) variant-level error heatmap, 3) audit trail for override changes.
Priya (eng-platform): timeline? we need a proposal for legal + sales by EOD Friday.
Lina (eng-runtime): I'll draft the API + sample JSON, push PR by Thursday.
Marco: I'll mock dashboards by Wednesday.
Jo (eng-sre): I'll add alerts and an oncall runbook entry.
Priya (eng-platform): awesome — thanks everyone. @Console Bot once Lina's PR lands can you add the checkbox to the rollout modal behind a feature flag?
Console Bot: scheduled: feature-flag `tenant_isolation_enhancements` created.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime change set #4862 -> staging.
Priya (eng-platform): closing loop — please add short blurb to release notes about the new `required_dedicated` routing and the explicit hosted-fallback consent.
Marco: will do. :thumbsup:
